I oppose all reproductive healthcare abortion restrictions for veterans. ALL people deserve the privacy to choose their own healthcare options.  No law could force someone to donate a kidney or even donate blood in emergency situations. The very idea that government should be able to force a person to donate their body to host a growing fetus is absurd. If a person does NOT want a fetus growing in their body, they should have the freedom to have it removed.

Any restriction on abortion are based solely on religion and have no place in the laws of this country.  

There are many things I would rather my tax dollars not support, like bombing children already born. Or starving them. Or giving tax breaks to billionaires. Or paying for department of defense golf courses.
